nodes.title: 01 · Spec Parser
nodes.prompt: Decide whether the Spec is sufficient. Ask only for blocking gaps in interfaces, timing, reset, latency, or test expectations; record non-blocking assumptions.

nodes.title: 02 · RTL Planner
nodes.prompt: Read the Spec and plan the module and file structure for the RTL project.

nodes.title: 03 · Coder
nodes.prompt: Implement each RTL file from the Planner structure, one file at a time.

nodes.title: 04 · Tester
nodes.prompt: Compile all RTL, run the teacher TB, and evaluate area and power. Emit test_report.json; the orchestrator compresses it into failure_packet.json.

nodes.title: 05 · Diagnoser
nodes.prompt: Read only failure_packet.json plus the relevant spec excerpt and candidate interfaces. Output repair_brief.json (root-cause hypothesis, files, symbols, constraints, verification targets). No RTL.

nodes.title: 06 · Patch Agent
nodes.prompt: Read only repair_brief.json and the named RTL files. Return complete updated files; the orchestrator re-runs the Tester.
